privacy.title: Nex Controls Privacy Policy
privacy.intro1: At Nex Controls, protecting your privacy is fundamental. We are committed to safeguarding the personal data we collect and use. This Privacy Policy aims to clarify how we handle this information whenever you access or use our sites, applications, tools, and other resources (together, the “Services”).
privacy.intro2: We comply with applicable legislation, including Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (Law nº 13.709/2018 – LGPD), and apply clear, responsible, and secure measures to protect your privacy throughout your entire interaction with us.
privacy.section1Para1: We collect personal data in different ways, always with the aim of providing a safe, personalized experience aligned with your expectations when using our Services.
privacy.section1Para2: We collect information you provide directly through contact forms or sign-ups on our website/application. This information includes, for example:
privacy.section1Item4: Platform usage history, necessary for the creation and management of your account.
privacy.section1Para3: We also record your communications with us via emails, social media interactions, or customer support.
privacy.section1Para4: Automatically, we record some technical and navigation information while you use our Services. This includes data such as IP address, browser type and settings, device type, and operating system. We also use cookies and similar technologies to store preferences, keep sessions active, and improve your platform experience. We do not collect sensitive data, financial information, or other details beyond what is essential to meet your needs.
privacy.section2Title: PURPOSES AND LEGAL BASES FOR DATA PROCESSING
privacy.section2Para1: The information is primarily processed to contact you in order to inform about new features, updates, offers, or opportunities, and also to send requested quotes, always respecting your consent where required by law. Sending communications and offers is a separate, optional purpose based on consent, which can be withdrawn at any time, and is distinct from the processing of registration and purchases, whose legal bases are described in section 8.
privacy.section2Para2: Additionally, we process personal data to comply with legal obligations, respond to requests from competent authorities, and exercise our rights in potential judicial or administrative proceedings. We may also use anonymized or aggregated data — which does not allow identifying individuals — for analysis, performance studies, development of new solutions, and continuous improvement of our models and features.
privacy.section3Para1: We keep your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Policy, including compliance with legal and regulatory obligations, resolution of potential disputes, and preservation of service security and integrity.
privacy.section3Para2: This retention period may vary depending on factors such as the nature of the data collected, the specific processing purpose, legal or regulatory requirements, and your account settings on the platform.
privacy.section3Para3: When the applicable period expires or the data subject requests, where possible, the data will be securely deleted or anonymized, allowing its use only for statistical purposes, analysis, or internal improvements without identifying the subject. Data subject to legal retention (tax records and access logs) is kept for the periods described in section 8.
privacy.section4Para1: As the subject of your personal data, you have several rights guaranteed by applicable law, particularly Brazil’s LGPD. Nex Controls respects these rights and ensures you can exercise them simply, clearly, and transparently.
privacy.section4Item1: Access to your personal information to know what data we maintain about you
privacy.section4Item2: Correction of incorrect, incomplete, or outdated information
privacy.section4Item3: Deletion of personal data, where applicable and within legal limits
privacy.section4Item4: Portability, enabling the transfer of data to another provider or controller
privacy.section4Item5: Restriction or opposition to processing in cases permitted by law
privacy.section4Item6: Withdrawal of consent, where processing is based on it (for example, communications and offers). Withdrawal does not affect processing needed to perform the contract or to comply with legal obligations.
privacy.section4Para3: You can exercise these rights, including portability, by sending a request to our privacy contact, contato@nexcontrols.com. The Customer Service channel (SAC) may also be used as an additional channel.
privacy.section5Para1: At Nex Controls, the protection of personal data is taken seriously. Therefore, we adopt basic security measures such as:
privacy.section5Item1: Restricted access only to authorized individuals
privacy.section5Item2: Secure passwords for systems and email accounts
privacy.section5Item3: Internal guidelines so our team follows good practices when handling information.
privacy.section5Para2: Although no measure is 100% risk-free, we strive to ensure that data is always secure and responsibly used.
privacy.section6Para1: We do not share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. We may occasionally provide information to service providers that assist in communication or sending quotes, provided these partners follow compatible security standards.
privacy.section7Para1: Nex Controls uses cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience, fix errors, personalize content, and ensure platform usability. Cookies are small files stored on your device when you access our services. They may be used for various purposes, including:
privacy.section7Item1: Platform operation: ensuring correct functioning of navigation and essential resources
privacy.section7Item2: Preferences and personalization: remembering your browsing settings and preferences
privacy.section7Item3: Statistics and usage analysis: understanding how users interact with the platform, supporting continuous improvements
privacy.section7Item4: Security: identifying and preventing risks such as unauthorized access or malicious activities.
privacy.section7Para2: We use strictly necessary cookies, which are essential for platform operation and do not allow user identification. Other cookies used for functionality, performance, and targeting are optional, and their storage can be refused or modified at any time by the user through browser settings or the consent banner displayed on the platform. Refusing some cookies may impact certain features.
privacy.sectionCadPara1: Registration and purchases in the customer area are handled by Nex Controls do Brasil LTDA (PE, Brazil), the data controller. The data protection officer contact (LGPD) is contato@nexcontrols.com.
privacy.sectionCadPara2: At registration we collect only the data needed for sales, delivery and invoicing (data minimization):
privacy.sectionCadItem1: Type of person (individual or company) and CPF/CNPJ tax ID
privacy.sectionCadItem2: Name or company name and trade name
privacy.sectionCadItem4: State registration (inscrição estadual) and IE indicator
privacy.sectionCadPara3: Purpose: sales, delivery and issuing invoices. Legal bases: performance of a contract and compliance with a legal (tax) obligation.
privacy.sectionCadPara4: Retention: tax data from orders is kept for 5 years (LGPD, art. 16, I). Access logs (date and time, IP and browser) are kept for 6 months, as required by art. 15 of the Marco Civil da Internet (Law No. 12,965/2014).
privacy.sectionCadPara5: Rights: you can view and correct your data in the customer area and exercise the other rights described in this Policy by e-mailing contato@nexcontrols.com.
privacy.sectionCadPara6: Deletion: deletion requests are handled by anonymization. Account access is blocked, personal data is erased and the tax data of orders is preserved for the legal period of 5 years. The CPF/CNPJ becomes available for a new registration.
privacy.sectionCadPara7: Hosting: registration data is hosted in Brazil (Supabase, region sa-east-1). Product images and manuals are stored on Cloudinary.
privacy.section8Para1: This Privacy Policy may be updated at any time to reflect changes in our data processing practices, service improvements, or new legal and regulatory requirements.
privacy.section8Para2: If significant changes occur, Nex Controls will inform users through appropriate means — such as platform notifications, emails, or other official communication channels — ensuring transparency during the update process.
privacy.section8Para3: The most recent version of the Policy will always be available on this page, with a clear indication of the effective date. We recommend checking this document periodically to stay informed about how your personal data is handled.

excluirConta.title: Delete your Nex Controls account
excluirConta.intro: This page explains how to request the deletion of your Nex Controls customer account, used on the website and in the "Nex Controls" Android app, both by Nex Controls do Brasil LTDA.
excluirConta.how1: Send an e-mail to contato@nexcontrols.com with the subject "Account deletion request" from the e-mail address registered in your account.
excluirConta.how2: In the app, tap Account and then "Excluir minha conta" (Delete my account): the app opens this message ready for you to send.
excluirConta.how3: If we need to confirm that the request is yours, we will reply to the same e-mail before deleting.
excluirConta.deleted1: Your access: sign-in is blocked and all open sessions (website and app) are ended.
excluirConta.deleted2: Your registration data: name or company name, trade name, CPF/CNPJ, e-mail, state registration, contact person, phone, WhatsApp and address.
excluirConta.deleted3: The CPF/CNPJ becomes available for a new registration.
excluirConta.keptTitle: What is kept and for how long
excluirConta.kept1: Orders already placed and their tax data (including the name, CPF/CNPJ and delivery address recorded on the order, and the invoices) are kept for 5 years, as required by law (LGPD, art. 16, I).
excluirConta.kept2: Access logs (date and time, IP and browser) are kept for 6 months, under art. 15 of the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework (Law 12.965/2014).
excluirConta.kept3: After these periods, this data is also deleted or anonymized.
excluirConta.time1: We reply to the request and complete the deletion within 15 days of confirmation, as set by the LGPD.
